name: Greek (Koine & Classical)
blurb: Learn the alphabet with breathings and accents, the article, the three declensions, the main tenses and voices, participles, pronouns and the high-frequency New Testament vocabulary, then read famous verses and simple lines of Plato and Aristotle. No browser has an ancient Greek voice, so audio uses a Modern Greek voice, which sounds quite different from ancient pronunciation.

sources.t: Perseus Digital Library, Tufts University (Smyth's Greek Grammar, LSJ)
Dickinson College Commentaries, Greek Core Vocabulary
James Strong, Greek in a Nutshell (Project Gutenberg)
